summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: YMAT) furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-29 disclosing that Chairman and CEO Jonathan Chiang will relocate full-time to the United States to lead U.S. operations and growth initiatives. No transaction, stake, price, or premium is stated; it is a strategic relocation, not a forced or abrupt departure, so no special-situation classification applies. The release also notes the previously filed Form F-3 shelf registration was declared effective 2026-09-23, a routine capital-markets mechanic. No advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is named. Watch for potential future U.S. manufacturing or aerospace/defense-adjacent announcements and use of shelf capacity.
